title: DSH Translation Glossary Quality Policy
description: Version 1 threshold policy for the dsh-translation-glossary audit command.

$schema.description: Optional URI reference to this JSON Schema.

minCoveragePercent.description: Minimum percentage of source code units replaced by winning glossary matches.

maxUnusedRules.description: Maximum number of enabled glossary rules absent from the supplied sample.

maxShadowedOccurrences.description: Maximum number of occurrences shadowed by overlapping glossary matches.

maxPatternMismatchRules.description: Maximum number of rules rejected by case or whole-word matching.

maxOutOfScopeRules.description: Maximum number of rules outside the selected source / target language pair.
